Primary goal: reduce support SLA and increase deflection. Current POC: embeddings for retrieval + lightweight reranker to improve precision on short, policy-heavy answers.

Latency SLO: 95th < 200ms for search path (embeddings+vector DB), desire <150ms for live chat rerank path
Throughput: bursty during peak shopping hours, requires autoscaling/burst capability
Cost sensitivity: SMB budget — looking for per-call predictability and minimization of embedding costs

Routing/fallback: simple single-region hosted API, optional fallbacks to lighter embedding model if cost cap reached
Security: SSO for team, SOC2 compliance evidence, audit logs for access to customer corpora, retention controls for PII
